## A Little About Me

I'm Joseph Asay, a Statistics student at Brigham Young University with an emphasis in Data Science. I'm fascinated by the process of using data to solve problems, uncover meaningful insights, and improve decision-making. My interests span the entire data science workflow, from collecting and transforming raw data to building automated pipelines, developing statistical models, and creating interactive dashboards that make complex information easier to analyze and understand. I'm particularly interested in applying these skills to sports analytics, with basketball analytics and player evaluation being my primary professional focus.

Through my work with the Utah Jazz, BYU basketball, and university research, I've had opportunities to work with sports data in both research and live game environments. I also enjoy building projects that bring together data collection, modeling, and visualization.
:::
